en.headline: Police arrest Pakistani couple over HK$22 million drug depot in Yuen Long village house
en.dek: Officers seized about 10 kilograms of ketamine, 30 kilograms of cocaine and a small amount of methamphetamine after intercepting a man leaving the premises on a motorcycle.
body: Police arrested a Pakistani couple on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs after uncovering a storage depot inside a village house in Yuen Long, seizing narcotics with an estimated street value of more than HK$22 million.

On the afternoon of 17 October, officers from the New Territories South Regional Headquarters intercepted a 38-year-old non-ethnic Chinese man as he left the house on a motorcycle. They found about 515 grams of suspected ketamine under the seat and arrested him. A search of the roughly 200-square-foot premises revealed his 27-year-old wife and their two young children.

Inside the living room, officers recovered 25 packages weighing about 10.2 kilograms of suspected ketamine hidden behind a television. In a bedroom wardrobe they found eight packages of about 29.9 kilograms of suspected cocaine and one package of about 47 grams of suspected methamphetamine. Cash of HK$15,000 and packaging tools including electronic scales, plastic bags and a heat sealer were also seized.

The couple, who had rented the house for about six months, have been charged and are due to appear at Tuen Mun Magistrates' Courts. Police said trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment and a fine of HK$5 million.

zh.headline: 警方元朗村屋破毒倉 拘巴基斯坦裔夫婦檢逾2200萬元毒品
zh.dek: 人員截查一名騎電單車離開的男子後，在村屋內檢獲約10公斤氯胺酮、約30公斤可卡因及少量冰毒。
body: 警方於元朗一間村屋破獲毒品儲存倉，檢獲估計市值逾2200萬元的懷疑毒品，並拘捕一對巴基斯坦裔夫婦涉嫌販運危險藥物。
10月17日下午，新界南總區人員在目標村屋外截查一名38歲非華裔男子，當時他正駕駛電單車離開。人員在電單車座位下發現約515克懷疑氯胺酮，隨即以涉嫌販運危險藥物將他拘捕。其後持手令搜查約200呎的村屋，發現其27歲妻子及兩名年幼子女在場。
搜查期間，人員在客廳電視機後方起獲25包、共約10.2公斤的懷疑氯胺酮；在睡房衣櫃內檢獲8包、共約29.9公斤的懷疑可卡因及1包約47克的懷疑冰毒。同時檢獲1.5萬元現金及電子磅、透明膠袋、封口機等包裝工具。
該對夫婦已租住涉事村屋約6個月，現已被控有關罪名，將於屯門裁判法院提堂。警方重申，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬極嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可被判終身監禁及罰款500萬元。
